from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or case type described in the document (e.g., '刑事二审', '行政诉讼', '刑事裁判涉财产部分执行')")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage of the case (e.g., '审判', '执行', '再审', '申诉')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
